http://wereworld.comicgenesis.com

Here's Wereworld. A NSFW furry fantasy webcomic with some science-fiction influences created by Rann that started in April 20th, 2002 and went on an "indefinite hiatus" January 13, 2013.

The comic is about a cyborg warrior from Earth on a faraway planet filled with were-creatures travels across this rich fantasy world with three therianthropic babes. Sand Cat, Gazelle, and Dragon. Each with their own mission. Love, humor, hardship, fun, and action.

Thought I should post this comic since it was a fun little read for an early 2000s comic. Thought it would be nice to post it here. I don't think anyone really knows about this comic and I doubt this comic will ever come back in any form or fashion since the creator of this comic put this comic in indefinite hiatus early 2010s and hasn't came back since then.

Earth Steve: The Aboriginies say that if you walk far enough you'll eventually
meet yourself,or something like that. Hello,Steve. Sidra Steve: Hello Steve.
ES:Thanks for sending me across the friggin' universe.
SS:Yeah,sorry. I wasn't myself there for awhile.
ES:Yeah,you were me!
SS:You're going to live now. Anika's going to save you. She'll need all the
help you can give her,though.
ES:Modoc told me about it. If it works...I'll be forever in your debt.
SS:Repay me by raising those wonderful kids and taking care of your wife.
ES:I will. I hope you can cure yourself as well.
SS:..We'll see.
ES:You and Modoc together make one clever bastard. I expect you'll find a way.
SS:When you get back,don't let the pain overwhelm you. Reach past it.
And you can't zonk yourself out on painkillers. Anika will need as much
backup as you can give her.
ES:I'll handle it. You know,Steve, you like my family,but you have the makings of one
back on this Sidra with virtually the same girl.
SS:Ehh...did you happen to look in a mirror when you were in my body? I think
Princess Anika sees me as a friend at best. Someone who can get her out of
jams. I didn't intend to get too involved with the locals until I got healed
but one look at Anika and my resolve crumbled.
ES:I know what you mean. I've been with mine for eleven years and I still
react that way when I look at her. Anyway,this wereworld Anika loves you too.
SS:How do you know that?
ES:Ohh...just a wild guess!
SS:But we're looking for her fiancee for fuck's sake!
ES:Ahh yes, ol'Jarin Zari. Be wary of that guy. Out of the thousands of
were immigrants that came to my Earth he's one of a few that we had to
throw in prison.
SS:That is...interesting. Thanks. I think we're running out of time here
good luck Steve. ES:Same to you. And thanks again. It's been...really wierd.
